DASHBOARD.TEXT_EMPTY_CHART_SUBTITLE: There are no recent customer interactions to analyze.

STATISTICS.TEXT_CALL_COUNT_TOOLTIP: The total number of calls your organization received during the given time period.
STATISTICS.TEXT_CUSTOMER_ENGAGEMENT_TOOLTIP: This score reflects the quality of customer interactions, based on the tone and content of every conversation. Low values indicate a higher risk of churn, while high values suggest stronger customer satisfaction.
STATISTICS.TEXT_CALL_DURATION_TOOLTIP: The average call duration during the given time period. Longer calls may suggest more complex issues, or more resources spent on troubleshooting.
STATISTICS.TEXT_MOST_POPULAR_TOPIC_TOOLTIP: The most frequently discussed topic in calls during the given time period.

TOPIC_TRENDS_ITEM.TEXT_FREQUENCY_TOOLTIP: The number of calls linked to this topic during the given time period.
